verdict.line: You lose if you get caught by Ornn's Q into E combo between levels 3-5; you win late by kiting his melee engage with ranged poison poke.

brief.thesis: This is a measured 45.5% win rate over 1351 games with the lane itself even but solo-kill advantage sitting with Ornn — meaning you don't lose the farm exchange, you lose the all-in. Ornn has no ranged pressure of his own, so every bad trade you take happens because you walked into his Volcanic Rupture (Q) slow and then ate Searing Charge (E) off a wall. Play the lane like Ornn is dangerous only when he commits, and farm from range the rest of the time.

theirWindow.what: Ornn lands Q (Volcanic Rupture) to slow you, then charges E (Searing Charge) into terrain for a shockwave knockup — this is the exact combo OP.GG flags. Stay off jungle walls and river terrain in this window and never trade standing still after his Q lands.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and freely poke with E (Toxic Shot) autos and Q (Blinding Dart); he has no tool to punish you at range until Volcanic Rupture (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) or Searing Charge (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) comes back.

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: This is the dominant start at 68.3% pick and 46% win rate — the extra sustain from two potions covers you through the level 3-5 all-in window where Ornn has solo-kill pressure.

boots.why: Ornn's passive (Living Forge) gives him bonus armor and magic resist from everything he builds, so the flat magic penetration keeps your Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart relevant as he stacks resistances.

core.why: The highest-win-rate first core item (50.2% over 424 games) — the attack speed and proc damage let you stack Toxic Shot fast in trades without standing in his melee range longer than necessary.
Burn damage scales against a champion who will be building tank stats, and it stacks with your poison DOTs for sustained trade damage.
Completes the most-played core path and adds the ability haste/burst you need once Ornn's R (Call of the Forge God) starts threatening team fights.

runes.keystoneWhy: Punishes Ornn for standing in your attack range during trades — since Blinding Dart (Q) only shuts down his basic attacks and not his Q/E/W/R, you need the stacked-auto damage amplification to win trades he's willing to take.

summoners.why: This is the dominant pick at 87.8% — Flash lets you dodge the Searing Charge (E) shockwave or a Forge God (R) engage, and Ignite closes out kills in the short trade windows when his Q and E are both down.

playing.title: Blind only stops his autos
playing.detail: Blinding Dart (Q) nullifies Ornn's basic attack damage but does nothing to his Q, E, W, or R — don't rely on it to survive his all-in combo, only to win pure auto-attack trades.

playing.title: Avoid walls at levels 3-5
playing.detail: OP.GG explicitly flags the Volcanic Rupture (Q) into Searing Charge (E) combo — Ornn needs to hit terrain with E to get the knockup shockwave, so staying off jungle walls and river edges removes his biggest kill threat.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Searing Charge sits at 14s early, dropping to 12s at max rank — once it whiffs or gets used to clear a wave, that's your window to step up and trade freely.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to disengage
playing.detail: Move Quick's (W) passive speed bonus is removed the moment you're struck, so react to his Q fissure landing by repositioning before it hits rather than after.

playing.title: Prioritize CS over forced trades
playing.detail: The data shows Ornn holds solo-kill advantage, so play this lane for farm and poke rather than forcing all-ins until your item spike.

playing.title: Zone with traps pre-6
playing.detail: Drop Noxious Traps (R, 1s cooldown) in brush and river entrances to deny jungle ganks and buy vision during his all-in windows.

playing.title: Kite hard after your spike
playing.detail: Once Statikk Shiv and Liandry's Torment are online around levels 9-13, your ranged poke outpaces his melee engage — force him to walk through poison to reach you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Ornn’s Volcanic Rupture (Q) – Searing Charge (E) combo!
